text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Nurses Registration (Committees) Regulations.
In these Regulations, “committee” means any committee constituted under regulation 3.
The Board may constitute such number of committees for any general or special purpose which, in the opinion of the Board, may be better dealt with or managed by the committees.

A committee shall —

(a) perform such duties as the Board may direct; and

(b) subject to any directions of the Board, regulate its own proceedings. Number and term of office of members
The number and term of office of the members of any committee and the number of those members necessary to form a quorum shall be determined by the Board.
